description.zh:
需要查询日志的RequestId。
API 请求的唯一标识符（UUID格式，且必须为大写）。
description.en:
The request ID of the log to query.
The unique identifier of the API request (in UUID format and must be uppercase).

descriptions.zh: 通过 RAM 授权或角色扮演，支持跨 RAM 用户或跨阿里云账号之间查询调用日志。详见授权方式，请参见[跨账号API错误诊断授权](~~2868101~~)。
descriptions.en: By using RAM authorization or role assumption, you can query call logs across RAM users or across Alibaba Cloud accounts. For more information about authorization, see [Cross-account API error diagnostics authorization](~~2868101~~).
